intro.text: A sea bordering the Crimson Sea and four others, ringed by mountain ranges that leave the Crimson Sea as one of the few ways in.
A pentagonal sea of midnight aether spores, bordering the Crimson Sea and four others. Mountain ranges surround it, leaving the Crimson Sea as one of the few ways in.

description.text: It is counted the most dangerous of the seas because of the Sorceress and her Midnight Essence servants, which hunt anyone entering their waters. Being as black as the spores, they are very hard to see in the churning sea.
Its dark spores soak up the sun's heat, so it is noticeably warmer than other seas. Some feel that its seethe sounds different as well.
